item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Adaptive Digital Twin for Crack-Free Powder Compaction: From Green State to Fatigue Performance (GeDiRL), EFRE1134, Progr.FESR 2021-2027 + Prediction and prevention of cracks in powder metallurgy (Funds for new projects development Peer) (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-04 Automatica

In Powder metallurgy the transformation of metal powder into solid components using pressure and heat requires precise control over material behaviour and hydraulic actuation since internal cracks and density inhomogeneities can develop. Based on recent research conducted by UNIBZ in collaboration with GKN Sinter Metals a prototype of an industrially implementable methodology for the prediction and prevention of crack risk should be developed. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: AMI-Q Lab (Additive Manufacturing Advanced Process Monitoring and Intelligence Quality Lab), EFRE1156, Progr. FESR 2021-2027 + Additive manufacturing of metals and polymers; Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF); process monitoring and optimization … (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-04 Tecnologie e sistemi di lavorazione

The research contract holder will conduct scientific work on Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) of metals and polymers. Tasks include planning and carrying out experimental trials; acquiring and synchronizing machine, process, optical and acoustic monitoring data; and correlating these data with ex-situ quality information obtained by computed tomography. The researcher will develop data pipelines, quality metrics, and data-driven and machine-learning models for anomaly detection, quality prediction, and process-parameter optimization. Further activities include validating the models through metal and polymer demonstrators, documenting and publishing scientific results... (see call)

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Development of innovative methodologies for the verification and validation of scientific cameras performance for space missions - 2026_CDR_DAER_2 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

This research activity focuses on developing innovative methodologies and techniques for verifying and validating scientific cameras and their acquisition chains. It will define experimental procedures, quantitative metrics, and models to characterize optical, radiometric, and functional performance, assess the quality and reliability of payload science data, and quantify uncertainties associated with the instrumentation, observation scenarios, and data-processing chain. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Mechanical characterization of planetary surfaces - 2026_CDR_DAER_3 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

The objective of this position is to define a methodology and instrumentation architecture for characterizing the mechanical properties of planetary surfaces in a space environment. Planned applications include in-situ surface exploration scenarios for Solar System small bodies, including lunar and asteroid missions. The position will involve numerical modeling, laboratory experimental activities, prototyping and instrumentation development, and data analysis.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Development of new electrically conductive/dissipative cement-based materials suitable for efficient “Power-to-Heat” conversion (Univ. PERUGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-24 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IMAT-01 Scienza e tecnologia dei materiali

The project involves the study and analysis of innovative cementitious mixtures with high electrical conductivity and dissipation properties for electrothermal conversion. The project involves the thermal and electrical characterization of the cementitious mixtures developed, the selection of the most promising mixtures, and the study of the corresponding fabrication methods and possible device layouts suitable for their use in the energy sector (“Power to heat” and thermal storage). An analysis of potential applications in the energy sector and their implications for other sectors is also planned.

The development of Physical AI systems, with particular emphasis on advanced autonomous robotics, requires methodologies and tools that enable the efficient design, training, and deployment of machine-learning solutions on resource-constrained embedded hardware platforms. In this context, the project aims to develop an open-source, modular, and scalable framework for designing, training, and deploying physics-aware neural networks for the modelling, estimation, and control of physical systems, with particular emphasis on model-structured neural networks (MSNNs). item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Precision-Aware Quantum Circuit Design and Compilation - 2026_CDR_DEIB_10 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-24 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-05 Sistemi di elaborazione delle informazioni

Within the SPQR – Smart Precision for Quantum Resilience project, the selected candidate will contribute to the design of exact and approximate quantum circuits and to the development of methodologies for automating their synthesis, compilation, and optimisation. The activities will address trade-offs among precision, reliability, success probability, and computational resources, with applications to quantum machine learning, combinatorial optimisation, quantum cryptanalysis, and quantum search algorithms. They will also cover resource estimation and selective quantum error correction strategies.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-05 Sistemi di elaborazione delle informazioni

E4RL aims to turn videos of human activities into a resource for training robots, reducing reliance on manually designed simulations and costly robotic data collection. The project will convert first-person videos into egocentric 4D representations: 3D reconstructions of the scene and its evolution over time. It will recover the structure of the environment, the objects involved, and the person’s pose and motion, describing where elements are located, how they are used, and what role they play in completing tasks.
